scope_note: Only the listed pages/snippets were reviewed in this round. Existing R87 ledgers cover Damasio, Man et al., Lyon and Kuchling, LeDoux, and Berridge/Robinson sources already used there. No restricted full text is redistributed.

sources.title: The revised International Association for the Study of Pain definition of pain: concepts, challenges, and compromises
sources.scope_read: Abstract, revised definition and accompanying notes as exposed in the retrieved full-text page.
sources.use: Supports the established distinction between pain and nociception and warns against inferring pain solely from sensory-neuron activity.

sources.title: Liking, wanting, and the incentive-sensitization theory of addiction
sources.scope_read: Abstract and retrieved sections describing distinct wanting and liking systems and dopamine-related dissociations.
sources.use: Supports the two-sided non-equivalence of incentive motivation and hedonic liking.

sources.title: Coming to terms with fear
sources.scope_read: Abstract and search-exposed passage distinguishing defensive responses from conscious fear.
sources.use: Constrains any inference from defensive control to conscious fear.

sources.title: Phantom Limb Pain: Mechanisms and Treatment Approaches
sources.scope_read: Abstract, introduction and retrieved mechanism overview.
sources.use: Documents pain perceived in an absent body region and multiple peripheral and central mechanisms; used only against a simple current-tissue-deficit equivalence.

sources.title: A review of current theories and treatments for phantom limb pain
sources.use: Corroborates that pain may be localized to an absent limb and that current mechanisms are not reducible to ongoing local tissue injury.

prior_art_assessment: All component dissociations have substantial direct prior art. R88 claims a project-level synthesis and protocol refinement, not discovery of wanting/liking, pain/nociception, or fear/defense distinctions.
